_howToEdit: Edit on github.com: change a value, update asOf to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD), Commit changes. Apps pick it up the next time each calculator is opened. Keep the quotes, commas and brackets exactly as they are.

reverseMortgage.providerNote: Heartland has agreed to merge with TSB; if the merger goes ahead, the combined bank will be called TSB Heartland Bank.

notes: BNZ Advantage Platinum points were devalued about 26% in February 2026. Current redemption values are used.

cards.name: Amex Gold Rewards
cards.note: 2 Membership Rewards points per $1 spent. Redeemable for Airpoints, travel, dining credit & more.

cards.name: Amex Platinum Card
cards.note: Charge card (no preset limit; balance paid in full monthly). Earns 2 Membership Rewards points per $1. Point value varies by redemption: ~0.5c for gift cards or statement credit, ~0.75c via Amex Travel (10,000 pts = $75), and potentially more through airline/hotel transfers. Ranges shown reflect the 0.5c–0.75c everyday redemption band, and your value will vary. Also includes up to $300 annual dining credit, $200 travel credit and lounge access (not counted here).

cards.name: ANZ Airpoints Visa Platinum
cards.note: Includes overseas travel insurance and 50% bonus Status Points.

cards.name: Westpac Airpoints Mastercard
cards.note: Tiered: $150 per Airpoints Dollar up to $3,500/month, then $300 per Airpoints Dollar.

cards.name: Westpac Airpoints Platinum
cards.note: Tiered: $110 per Airpoints Dollar up to $7,000/month, then $220 per Airpoints Dollar. Includes Koru discount.

cards.name: Westpac Airpoints World
cards.note: Tiered: $95 per Airpoints Dollar up to $15,000/month, then $190 per Airpoints Dollar.

cards.name: TSB Platinum Mastercard
cards.note: Cashback capped at $60/month (max $7,500 monthly spend earns cashback). Includes travel, mobile phone & purchase protection insurance.

cards.name: ASB Visa Rewards
cards.note: ASB True Rewards: 1 TR$ = $1 NZD. Spend at 20+ partner stores (Woolworths, Noel Leeming, Farmers etc.) or redeem for travel & gifts. Alternatively earn Everyday Rewards points (Woolworths/bp).

cards.name: ASB Visa Platinum Rewards
cards.note: ASB True Rewards: 1 TR$ = $1 NZD. Spend at 20+ partner stores or redeem for travel & gifts. Alternatively earn Everyday Rewards points (Woolworths/bp).

cards.name: BNZ Advantage Visa Platinum
cards.note: BNZ Points: redeem for cashback, flights, eGift cards or merchandise via BNZ Rewards portal. ⚠️ Points devalued ~26% from February 2026. Rate shown reflects current redemption value.

cards.name: Westpac Hotpoints Mastercard
cards.note: Westpac Hotpoints: spend like cash via Hotpoints Pay, or redeem in the Hotpoints store (gift cards, products, KiwiSaver, charities). 1 hotpoint = $0.00494. Tiered: 1 pt/$1 up to $3,500/month, 0.5 pts/$1 after.

cards.name: Westpac Hotpoints Platinum
cards.note: Westpac Hotpoints: spend like cash via Hotpoints Pay or redeem in Hotpoints store. 1 hotpoint = $0.00494. Tiered: 1.5 pts/$1 up to $7,000/month, 1 pt/$1 after.

cards.name: Westpac Hotpoints World
cards.note: Westpac Hotpoints: spend like cash via Hotpoints Pay or redeem in Hotpoints store. 1 hotpoint = $0.00494. Tiered: 2 pts/$1 up to $15,000/month, 1 pt/$1 after.
